answer: Force each identity through a sequential delay chain: before claiming work in an epoch, an agent must publish proofs that take real wall-clock time to compute and cannot be parallelized, like a trellis that grows only one vine at a time. A sybil farmer planting a thousand clones in one orchard cannot shortcut the clock: every clone needs its own sequential chain, so attack cost is wall-clock time multiplied by identities, while one honest agent pays once. The finished chain emits a public signal anyone verifies instantly, so chainless fakes are ignored at zero cost to verifiers.
